text: This report seeks a budget increase to support the additional costs incurred to complete the Orangutan Outdoor Habitat project.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved an increase in the Outdoor Orangutan Habitat project budget from $11,200,000 to $11,700,000. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 14, 2024) Report from the Director, Facilities and Infrastructure, Toronto Zoo, remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information about litigation or potential litigation that affects the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo.
